Commentary.Commentary: Mavi was fast and fiery to begin with and jolted the opposition early up. It was Anukul Roy who ran away with the show. He varied his pace to perfection, extracted substantial purchase from the track and outfoxed the opposition nonchalantly. His figures read - 6.5-2-14-5 which happens to be his career-best. India will be aiming to show the same ruthlessness to finish things off. Shouldn't take them long to chase this one down. Join us shortly.

India have been absolutely rampant! What a terrific display of skills on show from the Men in Blue. It is hard to blame the Papua New Guinea side as they have much less experience and were found wanting against pace, seam, bounce as well as spin. Nothing significant to write about their batting. You can make that out from the final score. Only three batsmen found themselves in double digits.

OUT! That's the final nail in the coffin! It has been a tremendous display from the left arm orthodox. Take a bow, young man. Bowls a loopy ball around off, extracts appreciable spin and bounce to breach the defense of Kamea and hits the timber. PAPUA NEW GUINEA ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 64!
Tossed up delivery, kept out watchfully.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Semo Kamea is the last man in.

OUT! Roy is weaving his magic! Bowls this one slow through the air and gets it to spin away. Tau goes for a drive but is not quite to the pitch of the ball. Mistimes it towards the cover region where Gill leaps to take a fine catch.
Shorter in length, punched off the back foot to point.
Strides forward to the tossed up ball and defends it nicely.
Tossed up ball, takes off. Swiped to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, left alone.
An appeal for an LBW turned down! Coming in with the arm, Tau misses and is hit on the pads. No interest shown by the umpire as it was sliding down leg.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full ball, pushed back to the bowler.
Shiva Singh comes on for a bowl.
Slider again, Arua tries to defend it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Boge Arua comes out to bat.

OUT! Too much of skill in show at the moment. The Indian side is completely dominating the proceedings. Bowls the straighter one this time, Tau plays for the away spin but it is absent. Misses the line completely to get his stumps rattled. Third wicket for Anukul Roy. He has bamboozled the young batsmen with his variations.
In line of the stumps, Tau manages to block it.
Loopy delivery, worked with the angle to mid-wicket.
Beaten! Floated outside off, Tau pushes at it but gets foxed.
Coming in with the arm, Tau aims to keep it out but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Fullish ball outside off, driven off the front foot to covers.
Well bowled! Good length ball in the probing zone around off, Tau feels for it but is beaten by the pace.
Fractionally overpitched, driven off the front foot to point.
Full and outside off, Tau slashes at it but misses.
That's hit the batsman on his pads. One run added to the total. Leg byes given by the umpire.
James Tau is the new man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Full and fast yorker, tailing in. Morea looks to block it but it is too good for him. Misses it completely to get his stumps rattled. Papua New Guinea continue to follow a downward spiral.
Loopy ball around off, patted to mid off. Wicket maiden for Roy, good stuff from the youngster.
Floated around off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Leke Morea comes out to bat.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Slow through the air, drifting into Sam. He kneels and goes for the slog sweep but miscues it completely towards deepish mid on. Mavi is placed in the correct position and doesn't have to move much. Lines up the ball and pouches it safely.
Quick and flat, pushed off the back foot to the off side.
Hangs back to the shortish ball and keeps it out.
Tossed up delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Low full toss outside off, Tau throws his bat at it but gets an outside edge towards gully.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads.
Good length ball outside off, Tau pokes at it but gets beaten.
Shuffles across to the length ball and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Well bowled! Fuller length ball well outside off, Tau goes for a drive but is beaten on the inside edge.
Kamlesh Nagarkoti comes in to bowl his next spell.
Short of a length outside off, Tau leaves it alone.
Roy tries to hit that ball on the off side but is beaten. It goes straight to the keeper.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Back of a length ball, Tau punches it on the off side for one.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Kevau Tau comes in next.

OUT! Bowled' em! Good length ball, does't turn much after pitching but just enough to pass the tentative bat of Arua to hit the top of off stump. The lights flash and Arua walks back to the hut. PNG have lost half their side now.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short this time, outside off, Sam cuts it behind point for a brace.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tossed up, Arua hits it back to the bowler.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

DROPPED! For Mavi's defense, he can use the wind as an excuse. Short ball, Arua not in control of the pull and the ball flies to the fine leg fielder, Mavi who comes under the ball but doesn't manage to get his hands below it. Surely wind a factor. The batsmen come through for the second run.
Outside off, Arua tries to poke at it and the ball goes to the gully fielder.
Drinks has been called on for.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Almost another one. Another good call from the umpire. Length ball in line of the stumps, doesn't spin much and hits Sam on his pad after taking a small inside edge.
Length ball, spining away from Sam who comes down the track and defends it on the off side.

High but just safe. Arua tries to heave this away over mid-wicket but just gets a top edge to this length ball and it flies to the mid-wicket region. Manjot, dives but the ball is a bit far from him. They run through.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

NOT OUT! Arua is beaten by the spin here. Bowled at a good length and it spins away from Arua. The keeper collects the ball and takes the bails off in a flash. Arua looks in but the umpire takes no chance and goes up.
Third umpire is been refereed to for a stumping effort. Should be in.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Elegantly done! Pitched up ball on off, Arua drives it through covers. Doesn't time it well enough to reach the boundary but they come back for the third run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman does well to leave that bouncer.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Arua takes on Roy and puts his dancing shoes to whip it away. Darts this on a good length, on middle and leg, Arua steps out of his crease and smacks it over mid-wicket to the fence.
Ohh! Almost gets an edge to it. Good length ball, around off, Arua tries to get bat on it but the ball just misses the outside edge.
Shortish ball, Roy pulls this towards mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Deliberately done! Outside off, Sam opens the face of the bat and guides it towards the third man region for a boundary.
Outside off, Arua looks to cut this but gets a bottom edge to it. The ball goes to the keeper on the bounce.
Sinaka Arua walks in next.

OUT! Good catch by the keeper. And PNG have lost their fourth wicket. Length ball well outside off, going away from the batsman, Karaho pokes at it and gets a fat edge to it. Juyal dives to his right to take a smart low catch. Singh gets his first wicket.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Fuller again on leg, Sam works it down the leg side for one.
Pitched up, Sam plays it back to the bowler.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Time for Powerplay 2! Meanwhile, Arshdeep Singh comes into the attack.

NOT OUT! That was always going to be in favor of the batsman. Pitched up, Sam hits it towards mid on. They think of the run but Sam is rightly sent back. The fielder there hits the timber at the striker's end but the batsman is well in.
Third umpire has been called for a run out decision. Looks not out at the first go. The umpire doesn't want to take a chance and goes up.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Gives this ball some flight and Sam defends it.
Floated delivery on leg, Sam flicks it away behind square to pick up a couple of runs.
Tossed up, Sam defends this onto the ground.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Anukul Sudhakar Roy comes into the attack.

Nervy moment! Full delivery outside off, Sam goes for the drive but gets an outside edge down to third man. The batsmen go for the second run. The throw from the fielder comes into the keeper who collects it but is a bit unaware of the situation. Has a chance to effect a run out at his end but throws it back to the bowler. A run easily taken.
FOUR! Shoddy fielding! Another short ball, angling down. Sam plays it awkwardly and manages to get it past the keeper to the fine leg fence.
Shortish this time, Karaho rises with the bounce and fends at it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Almost a replica of the previous ball and keeps it out watchfully.
Good length ball around off, angling in. Karaho hangs back and blocks it.
Two Wides! Mavi loses his radar and slips this one down the leg side. Sam tries to glance it but misses. The keeper dives and doesn't stop it cleanly. A run taken.
FOUR! Outside off, on a good length and Karaho just guides the ball through point for his first boundary. The ball races away to the fence.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.
Back of length ball, shapes into Karaho who misses his flick. The ball hits his thigh pad.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Vagi Karaho is the next batsman in.

OUT! Third wicket for the Indians. And Nagarkoti is to be credited for this. Brilliant work from him at mid-wicket and a direct hit at the non-striker's end sees the end of Atai. Length ball on leg, Sam works it on the leg side and the ball goes to Kamlesh who is stationed there. He is quick in releasing the ball and hits the bull's eye at the bowler's end as Atai came down the pitch looking for a run and is lazy to get back as well and finds himself quite short of the crease. Atai has to take the long walk back. Two wickets and only a run from this over. Mavi is on song!
Ovia Sam walks in next to bat.

OUT! What a ball from Mavi! Certainly the best sight for any fast bowler. Yorker in line of the stumps and the ball comes back into Toua who looks to keep it out. He is beaten by the pace of the ball and it goes onto hit the leg stump which gets uprooted.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Wide. Bouncer! Toua ducks to evade it and the umpire signals a wide.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Ohh! Good bowling from Mavi. Back of a length ball on off and the ball nips back after pitching to go between the big gap between bat and pad.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Atai. Surely showing that he can bat. Similar way to get the second boundary. Short ball on middle and leg and Atai pulls this away again through deep square leg for another boundary. Good over for PNG this.

FOUR! First boundary of the day and nice way to get it. Short ball on middle and Atai picks up the length quickly and was in total control of it. Pulls this in front of square and the ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
Good running. Short ball on middle and leg, Atai pulls this to mid-wicket to pick up a brace. They ran the first one hard which enabled them to come back for the second.
Full again and Atai defends this onto the pitch.
Fuller this time, in line of the stumps and Atai plays it back to the bowler.
Good length ball, Atai doesn't bother playing at it.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.
Oops! Back of a length ball in line of the stumps, Atai jumps to defend it but the ball hits him on his glove and falls short of the fielder charging in from short gully. They pick up a quick single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Around off, Atai plays and misses.
Bye. Outside off, Atai getting fidgety and tries to put bat on ball, he misses and the ball goes to the keeper who fails to collect it. They pick up a bye.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On leg this time, Fires this one on a good length, Atai tries to flick it away but the ball hits him on his thigh pad. Stifled appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Similar ball, around off, Atai tries to flirt with it and misses again.
Outside off on a good length, Atai tries to poke at it and misses.
Length ball around off, swinging away from Atai, who leaves it alone.
Bouncer! Short ball on off and Toua does well to let it through.
Heagi Toua is the next batsmen.

OUT! That's the first wicket for the Indians and it has come in just the third over. Bowled at a good length around off and the ball nips back after pitching. Mahuru who is not the tallest of batsmen jumps and tries to get bat on it. Is a bit too late on the shot and the ball goes through and hits the top of his front pad. The Indians appeal and the umpire nods his head to send Mahuru back to the pavilion.
Fuller in length this time, on leg and Mahuru helps it on its way towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
Second slip in place now.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Around off on a good length and Atai cuts it through point for a run.

Where is the slip, captain? That would have been swallowed by the second slip. Length ball around off, Mahuru pokes at it and the ball flies through the slip cordon and goes to the third man region for one.
Fullish delivery outside off, left alone.
Nagarkoti is bowling into the wind and is failing to control the swing. Full toss well outside off, flayed off the outer half of the bat down to third man. A single taken.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Two Wides! Down the leg side, swinging down. Atai lets it go. The keeper dives to his right and makes a partial stop. A run taken.
Stump-to-stump line, defended stoutly off the back foot.
In the probing channel around off, shaping away. Atai plants his front foot across to allow it through.

Four Leg byes! Full delivery around leg stump, swinging further down. Atai looks to clip it away but his bat is a country mile away from the ball. It brushes his pads and beats the dive of the keeper to race to the fine leg fence.
Kamlesh Nagarkoti to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Hangs back to this one and keeps this one out watchfully. India right on the money.

Good bowling! Hits the deck hard and generates good bounce. Atai closes his bat face early and gets a safe leading edge towards point and sets off. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Concedes an overthrow.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Another play and a miss! Mavi is making the new ball talk. On a length, curling away. Atai pokes at it and gets foxed.
Good length outside off, seaming away after hitting the deck. Atai fiddles at it late and is beaten all ends up.

Ooh.. that's a shooter! Back of a length ball on off, takes off after pitching. Atai is caught in a tangle in an attempt to keep it out but ends up getting hit on the bottom hand. The ball lobs towards Shaw at second slip but falls well short of him. Atai is caught unawares as he is looking for a run but is rightly sent back before the throw comes in.
Starts off with a good length ball around off, shaping away. Atai points his bat skywards to allow it through.

The players make their way to the middle for their respective National Anthems. After the completion, we are set to get underway. Simon Atai and Igo Mahuru to open the batting for Papua New Guinea. Shivam Mavi to start off the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
Papua New Guinea U19 (Playing XI)- Simon Atai(wk), Igo Mahuru, Heagi Toua, Ovia Sam, Vagi Karaho(c), Sinaka Arua, Kevau Tau, Leke Morea, James Tau, Boge Arua, Semo Kamea.
India U19 (Playing XI)- Prithvi Shaw(c), Manjot Kalra, Shubman Gill, Abhishek Sharma, Himanshu Rana, Aryan Juyal(wk), Anukul Sudhakar Roy, Kamlesh Nagarkoti, Shivam Mavi, Shiva Singh, Arshdeep Singh.
PITCH REPORT - Tom Moody says that the pitch doesn't have that much grass. States that there are a lot of runs to be scored here. Feels that a forecast of rain might have led India to bowling first.
Papua New Guinea skipper, Vagi Karaho, says that everyone is good. Mentions that they are looking forward to play against India. Ends by saying that this is a big opportunity for them.

India skipper, Prithvi Shaw, says that they will bowl first. States that Ishan Porel will miss out due to a knee injury and Arshdeep Singh is taking his place. Mentions that they are getting used to the conditions and are shaping up well.
TOSS - India win the toss and opt to field.

Papua New Guinea, on the other hand, have an opportunity to learn a lot. They are a passionate side and enjoy their cricket. That is what they need to do and focus on leaving a mark on the opposition. This game will be telivised in their country. Definitely a day to cherish for a long time for them. Will the Men in Black come out and spring a surprise? Or will India run away with the show?

Hello and a warm welcome to the 11th game of the 2018 ICC Under-19 World Cup between India and Papua New Guinea. The three time champions have taken off like a plane takes off. They were in full flow against the Australians and stamped their authority on this big stage. Prithvi Shaw, the Indian skipper, lived up to the expectations and proved what an exciting talent he is. In the bowling department, Nagarkoti and Mavi consistently clocked speeds of around the 145 kmph which came as a surprise to many. However, Ishan Porel is likely to miss out due to an ankle injury and it provides an opportunity to the 18-year-old Arshdeep Singh to showcase his skills. The Men in Blue are firm favourites going into this contest.
